_doc: The lever bench: the envelope every specimen shares, the test load, and the rig. Design choices (kind default), chosen so the specimens are easy to compare and the rig is far stiffer than any of them.
name: bench

length.rule: The envelope's length, along the lever: every specimen fits in it

depth.rule: The envelope's depth, across the lever (up and down, as tested)

behind.rule: How far the envelope reaches behind the first bolt

pitch.rule: The two fixing bolts' spacing, in line along the lever

span.rule: From the first fixing bolt to the load bolt

boss5.rule: Radius of the solid boss round each fixing bolt's hole

boss4.rule: Radius of the solid boss round the load bolt's hole

fill.rule: The share of the envelope every specimen fills: they all weigh the same

load.rule: The test load at its largest, for the analysis: about 2 kg

angle.rule: The second load case: this far from straight down, towards the free end

filter.rule: The optimisation's filter radius: members stay about six print lines wide or more

windows.rule: The lightened plate's windows, in a row between the bolts

wall_length.rule: The rig's upright wall: length along the specimen

bolt_z.rule: Height of the specimen's bolts on the wall: the specimen clears the base below

gauge_gap.rule: From the gauge arm's underside to the top of the load bolt's head: room for a dial indicator's stem and plunger (change it to suit yours)

base.rule: The rig's base: how far it reaches back, for a G-clamp

arm_w.rule: The gauge arm's width (across the wall)

arm_reach.rule: How far the gauge arm reaches past the load bolt

top_bolt.rule: Depth of the gauge arm's bolts' nuts below the wall's top

eye.rule: Radius of the hanger's eye, for a strap or S-hook

reach.rule: The bracket: from its back (against the wall) to the load bolt

bracket_w.rule: The bracket's envelope across the wall (x)

bracket_h.rule: The bracket's envelope up the wall (y, printed)

plate.rule: The bracket's back plate: thickness against the wall

bracket_fill.rule: The share of the bracket's envelope every bracket fills: they all weigh the same

verify_cell.rule: The brackets' check: analysed again on cubes this size (and a quarter bigger, to see the numbers settle)
verify_cell.source: Stiffness changes under 5% from 1 mm to 0.8 mm cells (examples/bench/README.md)

lever_verify_cell.rule: The levers' check: analysed again on squares this size (and a quarter bigger)

bracket_filter.rule: The bracket's filter radius: members two cubes thick or more

wrench.rule: Room round each fixing bolt's axis for its head and a hex key, out from the back plate

boss_len.rule: The load boss's length along the load bolt
